one_sentence_story: Stanford's 1971 six-day basement prison showed how quickly unchecked hierarchy, anonymous uniforms, and leader coaching can corrupt decent norms — and how one brave outsider, Christina Maslach, broke the spell by refusing to play along.
so_what_for_you: Never let any leader serve as their own ethics referee, and remember that uniforms never absolve personal choice: two-thirds of guards refused cruelty, and one honest voice shut the whole system down.
